title: Wingspan
components: 40 Wooden action cubes (8 in each of 5 colors)
103 Food tokens (Invertebrate, Seed, Fish, Fruit, Rodent)
setup:
1. Each player receives a player mat, 8 action cubes of 1 color, 5 bird cards, 2 bonus cards, and 1 of each food token (5 total).
2. Keep up to 5 bird cards; for every bird kept, discard 1 food token (cards kept + food kept must equal 5).
3. Keep 1 bonus card and discard the other.
4. Roll the 5 food dice into the birdfeeder.
5. Deal 3 face-up bird cards into the bird tray.
6. Place 4 random end-of-round goal tiles onto the goal board.
procedure: Place 1 action cube on the leftmost exposed slot of one of the 4 rows on your mat:
Action A - Play a Bird: Pay the food cost printed on the bird card plus the egg cost of the column (0, 1, or 2 eggs). Trigger any 'WHEN PLAYED' (white) power.
Action B - Gain Food (Forest): Take food dice shown on the space from the birdfeeder. Then activate all 'WHEN ACTIVATED' (brown) powers in that forest row moving RIGHT to LEFT.
Action C - Lay Eggs (Grasslands): Take eggs shown on the space and place them on birds up to each bird's egg limit. Then activate all brown powers in that grassland row from RIGHT to LEFT.
Action D - Draw Cards (Wetlands): Draw bird cards shown on the space from the tray or deck. Then activate all brown powers in that wetlands row from RIGHT to LEFT.
endGame:
Game ends after Round 4. Calculate total score across 6 categories:
1. Printed Victory Points on played bird cards
2. Completed Bonus cards
3. End-of-round goal points
4. 1 point per egg stored on birds
5. 1 point per food token cached on birds
6. 1 point per card tucked beneath birds
tieBreaker: The tied player with the most unused food tokens in their personal supply wins. If still tied, victory is shared.
notes:
• Round length shrinks each round: R1 = 8 turns, R2 = 7 turns, R3 = 6 turns, R4 = 5 turns (because 1 cube is placed on the goal board each round).
• Birdfeeder Reroll rule: You may only reroll all dice in the birdfeeder if all dice in the feeder show the same face, or if the feeder is completely empty.
